limitations: The test covers synthetic single-hop immediate recall only.
It does not test multihop inference, broad knowledge acquisition, or long-term learning.
It does not establish improvement on GPQA, ARC-AGI, or any other public benchmark.
It is a local self-measurement without independent attestation or an external signature.
The same team and repository previously exposed synthetic LiveMemory single-hop demonstrations.
Lexical stemming, overlap thresholds, and recall behavior were tuned before this preregistration.
The coined entities and exact sentences are new, but the immediate-recall task form is already exposed.
The preregistered items are public in the same repository and are not a hidden holdout.
The local evaluator is not independent, and checksum binding is not E5 attestation.
